critical_findings_fixed.vulnerability: Hardcoded JWT Secret in Configuration Files
critical_findings_fixed.description: JWT signing secret was hardcoded in configuration files, exposing it in version control and deployment artifacts
critical_findings_fixed.impact: Complete authentication bypass, privilege escalation, data access
critical_findings_fixed.exploitation_scenario: Attacker obtains JWT secret from config files and forges valid tokens for any user

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff:
- JWT_SECRET = "protothrive_jwt_secret_2025..."
+ # JWT_SECRET must be set as a Cloudflare Workers secret
+ # Use: wrangler secret put JWT_SECRET
configuration_changes: Set JWT_SECRET via Cloudflare Workers secrets: wrangler secret put JWT_SECRET

critical_findings_fixed.vulnerability: Weak Content Security Policy with unsafe-inline
critical_findings_fixed.description: CSP policy allowed 'unsafe-inline' for scripts and styles, enabling XSS attacks
critical_findings_fixed.impact: Cross-site scripting attacks, code injection, session hijacking
critical_findings_fixed.exploitation_scenario: Attacker injects malicious scripts that bypass CSP due to unsafe-inline directive

configuration_changes: Generate unique nonce for each request
Implement strict CSP with nonce-based policy

critical_findings_fixed.description: No limits on array sizes for nodes/edges could cause memory exhaustion DoS
critical_findings_fixed.impact: Denial of service through memory exhaustion, server instability
critical_findings_fixed.exploitation_scenario: Attacker sends requests with massive arrays causing server memory exhaustion

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff:
- nodes: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
+ nodes: z.array(z.any()).max(1000).optional(), // SECURITY: Limit nodes to prevent DoS
configuration_changes: Limit nodes array to maximum 1000 items
Limit edges array to maximum 2000 items
Add request body size limits (1MB default)
Limit query result sets to 100 items maximum

critical_findings_fixed.description: Detailed error messages and stack traces exposed sensitive information
critical_findings_fixed.impact: Information leakage, system fingerprinting, attack surface enumeration
critical_findings_fixed.exploitation_scenario: Attacker uses detailed error messages to map system architecture and identify vulnerabilities

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff:
- details: error.message
+ // SECURITY: No details in production
configuration_changes: Remove detailed error messages from production responses
Add secure logging that redacts sensitive data
